approach: Cut the root application over atomically to the Go /v2 identity, derive one canonical VERSION from each accepted release tag, expose it through the exact --version contract, render immutable platform templates into isolated staging, and reject packaged-version mismatches before upload under Constitution 8.1.0. Local builds use development identity; rollback is pre-publication only and published releases fix forward.

decisions.why: Go semantic import versioning requires the suffix and one identity avoids active fallback paths
decisions.rejected: Keep the unsuffixed module or add a compatibility alias

decisions.decision: Regenerate contracts with only go_package metadata changed
decisions.why: The release changes language identity without changing protobuf or ConnectRPC behavior
decisions.rejected: Rename protobuf v1 packages or edit generated files

decisions.decision: Advance the reviewed descriptor baseline explicitly
decisions.why: go_package is descriptor metadata and the negative fixtures must continue proving wire compatibility
decisions.rejected: Keep the stale baseline or replace it without schema-diff review

decisions.decision: Keep v2 tag policy in the existing Go preflight
decisions.why: The dependency-free build tool already owns release validation before the package matrix
decisions.rejected: Duplicate the major rule in workflow YAML or Task

decisions.decision: Preserve version-1 persistence behavior and independent tool modules
decisions.why: Application release major is separate from data-format and development-tool identities
decisions.rejected: Mass-renumber v1 formats or migrate tools to the application major

decisions.decision: Defer version embedding until BUG-001 patches the scope
decisions.why: The current specification explicitly excludes platform and executable version metadata
decisions.rejected: Implement the discovered requirement without artifact traceability

decisions.decision: Supersede the BUG-001 version-embedding deferral and propagate one canonical release VERSION
decisions.why: The patched scope now requires Go, Darwin, Windows, and packaged verification to agree with the triggering tag
decisions.rejected: Keep hard-coded platform versions or derive each target version independently

decisions.decision: Authorize deterministic release-identity verification under Constitution 8.1.0
decisions.why: Tagged packages must prove executable and native metadata agree with the accepted tag before publication
decisions.rejected: Keep the Constitution 8.0.0 minimal gate and leave BUG-001 partially resolved

decisions.decision: Use development with zero-valued numeric metadata for empty local VERSION
decisions.why: Local build and package commands remain usable without allowing non-release artifacts to pass tagged verification
decisions.rejected: Require release SemVer for every local command or infer it from Git

decisions.decision: Standardize executable inspection as --version with exact single-line stdout
decisions.why: Every native runner needs a deterministic non-interactive contract that exits before runtime composition
decisions.rejected: Use an unspecified request, a subcommand, or JSON output

decisions.decision: Render checked-in platform templates into target-isolated staging paths
decisions.why: Packaging must not mutate the worktree or share target metadata outputs
decisions.rejected: Rewrite checked-in metadata temporarily or generate target files in shared paths

decisions.decision: Roll back only before publication and fix complete published releases forward
decisions.why: Atomic source identity and create-only release history prohibit dual identities and tag replacement
decisions.rejected: Retain dual module identities or replace a complete published release

FR-001.title: The governed application source identity MUST correspond to major version 2 before a v2 release is tagged.

FR-002.title: Release preflight MUST accept strict stable and prerelease semantic versions whose major version is exactly 2.

FR-003.title: Release preflight MUST reject every otherwise valid semantic version whose major version is not 2 before target packaging begins.

FR-004.title: Release preflight MUST continue rejecting malformed versions, leading-zero numeric components, leading-zero numeric prerelease identifiers, and build metadata.

FR-005.title: Every active application package and generated application binding MUST resolve through the v2 source identity with no active fallback to the previous identity.

FR-006.title: Regenerated contract artifacts MUST preserve existing protobuf package names, messages, field numbers, services, RPC directions, and wire behavior while recording the v2 language-package identity.

FR-007.title: The reviewed compatibility baseline MUST advance explicitly for the language-package identity change and MUST continue rejecting the established breaking-change fixtures.

FR-008.title: Session JSON and player-configuration JSON MUST remain at version 1 with no conversion, field-name change, or loss of compatible unknown data.

FR-009.title: Independent development-tool modules MUST retain their existing module identities and isolated dependency ownership.

FR-010.title: Active release documentation MUST use stable and prerelease v2 tag examples and MUST explain that accepted release-tag majors match the application module major.

FR-011.title: Completed specifications and migration records MUST retain their original paths, targets, and evidence as historical records.

FR-012.title: The migration MUST introduce no new Overseer or player interaction, public capability, credential handling, network behavior, or runtime state.

FR-013.title: Release preflight MUST derive one canonical application version from the accepted tag by removing only its leading v and MUST pass that value as the single VERSION input to every target package job.

FR-014.title: The Go build MUST embed the canonical release version, retain VCS metadata, and expose the exact pre-runtime executable --version contract.

FR-015.title: Darwin and Windows package metadata MUST render from the canonical version using immutable checked-in templates and isolated staged outputs.

FR-016.title: Numeric-only platform fields MUST derive their native numeric representation from the canonical version while human-readable metadata and executable reports retain the full semantic version.

FR-017.title: Every target package job MUST verify before upload that executable and applicable platform metadata versions agree with the triggering tag.

FR-018.title: Malformed or mismatched release VERSION MUST fail before upload; empty local VERSION MUST produce development identity and cannot pass tagged inspection.
